title: Newton's Laws of Motion
summary: Newton's three laws describe how forces change the motion of objects.

key_concepts.explanation: The tendency of an object to keep its state of motion.
The vector sum of all forces acting on an object.

outline.heading: First and second law
points: An object keeps moving at constant velocity without a net force.

outline.heading: Third law
points: Forces come in equal and opposite pairs.
The pairs act on different objects.

questions: Why does a rocket accelerate in empty space?
